newsitem.title: USA: SEI to sell Capital Resources division.
newsitem.headline: SEI to sell Capital Resources division.

text.p: SEI Investments said Friday it sold its Capital Resources division to an investor group led by Notre Capital Ventures II LLC and the head of Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette's asset consulting group William Nicholson for an undisclosed sum.

The unit posted more than $30 million in revenues in 1996 and usually runs a pre-tax profit margin of 10 percent to 20 percent, said John Angley, managing director of Capital's asset consulting group, in an interview.
Engli said the unit, which is headquarted in Chicago, will probably change its name but will retain all 100 employees.
DLJ's Nicholson will become chief executive of Capital Resources, SEI said in a statement, adding it expected the deal to close in August.
A SEI spokesman said the divsion had been up for sale since May 1995 but declined to discuss the sale price.
